copy.headline: You can see a lot of possibilities, but you don't necessarily necessarily condense them into a sustainable path.
copy.body: High openness will allow you to quickly see the layers, variables, and alternative explanations behind the problem, while low conscientiousness will make it easier for long-term dismantling, scheduling, closing, and repeated execution to slow down. The result is: the understanding runs ahead of the execution system, many branches have been opened in the brain, but the advancement of reality requires additional structures to keep up.
copy.strength_sentence: This combination makes it less likely that you will be trapped by a single answer, and is more suitable for discovering new questions that cannot be explained by the old framework.
copy.risk_sentence: The price is: the more complex the idea, the more likely it is that it will remain between conception, revision and starting over due to the lack of a closing mechanism.
copy.action_hook: Your priority action is not to reduce ideas, but to set next steps, cutoff points, and completion criteria for your most valuable ideas.
